text:
mira: Quick sync — we're starting onboarding for the new GPU capacity metrics (SM occupancy, per-host memory headroom, queue_depth_by_pool) that Hosted + Dedicated teams asked for. Need product/console + infra alignment on names, labels, and dashboard UX before we wire telemetry.

sanjay: TL;DR: agree. main asks: (1) consistent metric schema so routing/qos can query same fields, (2) 1s sampling for occupancy, 10s for queue depth, (3) labels: pool, model_variant, tenant_shard, qos_bucket.

alex: +1 on labels. also want an explicit "capacity_slot" label to indicate reserved vs burst for Dedicated. helps quota math.

mira: good call. product wants dashboard slices by Dedicated vs Hosted and a toggle for committed capacity vs available headroom. Dina — can console show both absolute and normalized % occupancy?

dina: we can. plan: two panels per pool: time series occupancy (%) and stacked histogram of queue depth by qos_bucket. add an annotation track for rollouts. UI question: do we surface tenant_shard at top-level or hidden filter?

anna_product: top-level filter ok but default to hide shard for privacy. product also wants a summary row showing 95th latency vs occupancy so SLO correlations are obvious.

jamie_infra: telemetry notes: exporters will emit these from runtime: sm_occupied_slots_total, sm_total_slots, gpu_memory_free_bytes, gpu_memory_total_bytes, pool_queue_depth. We'll surface derived metrics: sm_occupancy_ratio = sm_occupied_slots_total / sm_total_slots, memory_headroom_bytes = gpu_memory_free_bytes - reserved_by_dedicated. Need to define reserved_by_dedicated label mapping.

mira: can you paste the proposed PromQL snippets so we can iterate?

jamie_infra: sure — early draft: 
``` 
# occupancy ratio per pool
sum by (pool, model_variant, qos_bucket) (rate(sm_occupied_slots_total[30s]))
/ sum by (pool, model_variant, qos_bucket) (rate(sm_total_slots[30s]))

# memory headroom per gpu
(gpu_memory_free_bytes - gpu_memory_reserved_bytes) by (host, pool)

# queue depth distribution
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(pool_queue_depth_bucket[1m])) by (le, pool, qos_bucket))
```

mira: nice. A couple of asks: (A) use 1m aggregates for dashboard queries to avoid noisy charts in console; (B) include a "sample_rate" label on raw counters so we can track down-sampling; (C) ensure metric names start with "redwood_" to reduce collisions.

sanjay: +1 on prefix. we should also keep a stable alias mapping in a proto doc so SDKs and routing policies don't break when we rename.

alex: alerting side: propose two alerts per pool: occupancy_high_alert if sm_occupancy_ratio > 0.95 for 5m, and queue_backlog_alert if queue_depth_p95 > 20 for 2m. For Dedicated, different thresholds per committed tier. We'll need a label on pool indicating committed_tier.

anna_product: for rollout UX: we want a "canary" toggle in console to route a small % of traffic to a variant and show occupancy + latency deltas side-by-side. That requires metric tags to include route_id and rollout_id.

jamie_infra: route_id tag is fine. rollout_id might be ephemeral; suggest an optional label rollout="<id>" emitted by proxy at request annotation time. Telemetry pipeline will drop it by default after 24h.

dina: UX note: side-by-side only for short windows. we'll show a diff bar and a sparklines grid. Also adding a cost-estimate overlay (tokens/sec * $/token) is doable if infra exposes per-token counters.

mira: ownership: infra emits metrics, eng-platform builds dashboards, product defines UX requirements, and SRE/Oncall validates alerts. Assign owners: jamie -> metrics proto + exporter changes; alex -> alert playbooks; dina -> dashboard templates; sanjay -> routing/qos query contract; anna_product -> rollout UX acceptance.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly sync scheduled with eng-platform, infra, product on 1719877200 (in 11m).

mira: meeting agenda: finalize metric names & labels, agree sample rates, and decide the dedicated thresholds. Please add any prework to the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/gpu-metrics-onboard (I'll update with PromQL).

sanjay: prework: I'll push a small RFC with label enumerations and committed_tier semantics by EOD.

alex: I'll draft the alert runbooks and post them to #eng-oncall.

dina: I'll sketch dashboard wireframes and share a quick prototype link before the sync.

mira: thanks everyone — see you at the weekly. :thumbsup:
